text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having some business with Jungle Pocket,
I headed over to her hangout spot and found――

text_block_list.name: Stray Dog & Stray Cat
choice_data_list: Is that Pokke and—the animals from here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Animals are gathering and snuggling close to a dispirited Jungle Pocket...
The scene almost looks like a corner of a zoo.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is the fatigue building up from racing day after day?
It might be best to reconsider the upcoming schedule.
